title: Fix e2e.sh distro loop not splitting on spaces

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: IFS is set to newline+tab at script top, so 'for d in $DISTROS' treats the whole space-separated string as one token. Need to locally reset IFS or use an array.

comments.author: anon-31e9bd66
comments.content: Fixed: converted DISTROS from string to bash array, updated all loops to use ${DISTROS[@]}.
